verdict.rationale: Calendly's marketing names 'multi-host sales demos' as a pre-built event type and lists 'Round-robin & team scheduling' on its pricing page. Together these imply multi-host team events, but nothing explicitly describes a collective event that only shows slots when every required host is free. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of collective event types, the rule that slots require all hosts to be free, required vs optional host configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
